How we put the library together

Gold Trails brings together clear articles, a prospecting glossary, and creator profiles to help you explore the craft and science of finding gold.

Our articles link to supporting references and distinguish published explanations from suggested field routines. The Old-Timer is our editorial voice; content assembled with assistance from ChatGPT is labeled accordingly.

We are starting with a small collection and adding material as it is ready. Images used for atmosphere are illustrations, not evidence of a particular field result.
